verdict.rationale: Runpod's first-party docs describe Instant Clusters as fully managed multi-node compute with high-performance networking for training across multiple nodes, with no need to manage networking or cluster configuration. The "Instant" product name and credit-based, per-second billing suggest self-serve provisioning, but the docs never state outright that clusters skip a sales process. Missing for 10: interconnect specifics (fabric type or bandwidth), explicit confirmation that cluster provisioning is self-serve without sales contact, any detail on node or cluster size limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cluster provisioning.
